Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of LLY.
We delivered record revenue of $33.6 billion this quarter, representing 18% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 55 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2021.
We delivered record revenue of $33.6 billion this quarter, representing 18% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 18% to 12% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 55 basis points to 53.3%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
